title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
In the upcoming NBA game between Lakers and Rockets, originally scheduled for Monday, November 30, 2026 at 7:30 PM ET (as of creation of the first market related to the event):
If the Lakers win, the market will resolve to "Lakers".
If the Rockets win, the market will resolve to "Rockets".
If this market's outcome was definitively determined under its rules by the listed resolution sources before abandonment, that outcome will stand. Otherwise, the following no-result provisions apply. If the game is canceled, does not start by Wednesday, December 2, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or is abandoned with no official result by that time, this market will resolve 50-50.
The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods.
